entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: Woman from Sarpadia, sister of Tev, made eternally young by him; stabbed to death by Oliver Farrel.

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: Tymolin's brother, a planeswalker who became Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Kaylen the Dwarf
entities.description: Tymolin's lover, fell in battle to an Orc.

entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: Icatian priest who killed Tymolin after she refused him.

entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: Followers of Oliver Farrel who hunted Tymolin.

entities.name: Vaylesh
entities.description: Ebon Hand leader who captured Tymolin and used her as bait.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where the siblings grew up.

entities.name: Montford
entities.description: Place from which Oliver and the Farrelites hunted Tymolin.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: Realm opposed to the Goblin-Orc army.

entities.name: Tourach
entities.description: Figure Tymolin was proclaimed to be the incarnation of.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War in which the siblings were caught.

entities.name: Sianna
entities.description: Oliver's champion whom Tymolin would have replaced.

events.summary: Tev ignites his spark and enchants Tymolin with eternal youth.
events.quote: he ignited his Planeswalker spark and enchanted Tymolin with eternal youth

events.summary: An Orc-Goblin army besieges the Dwarven kingdom; Kaylen falls and Tymolin is banished.
events.quote: Kaylen would fall in battle to an Orc

events.summary: The Farrelites ambush the siblings; they are separated and Vaylesh and the Ebon Hand capture Tymolin.
events.quote: Tymolin was waylaid by Vaylesh and the Order of the Ebon Hand

events.summary: Oliver Farrel stabs Tymolin to death after she refuses him.
events.quote: was stabbed to death by Farrel

events.summary: Tev transforms into Tevesh Szat and slays all present with a Fireball.

relations.quote: She was the sister of Tev Loneglade
was stabbed to death by Farrel
Tymolin became the lover of Kaylen the Dwarf

relations.note: Avenged Tymolin by slaying all present
relations.quote: Tevesh avenged Tymolin by slaying all present
